deviceAddons.octoprintStopped: OctoPrint isn't connected to the printer.
deviceAddons.bambuStopped: The printer stopped answering: check that it is on and on the network.
deviceAddons.bambuCameraMissing: Only P1 and A1 printers show their camera here: X1, H2 and P2S send video that only Bambu's own apps play.
deviceAddons.bambuSlotUnset: Load filament there, or set it on the printer’s screen.
deviceAddons.bambuSlotNote: As in Bambu Studio, a filament can only go to a slot with the same filament type. Brand and colour can differ.
deviceAddons.u1HeadUnset: Load filament, or set its type on the Tool heads card.
deviceAddons.u1HeadNote: As in Snapmaker’s own app, a filament can only go to a head with the same filament type and nozzle size. Brand and colour can differ.
deviceAddons.needsAttention: Needs attention on the printer screen
